task: There is RNA-seq 10X Cell Ranger data and BCR-seq data from 6 patients. You can find metadata related to the patients in the metadata.csv file. For each patients, two measurements was taken: one before influenza vaccination (e.g. 09-0) and the other 7 days after the vaccination (e.g. 09-7). For the analyzes below, use only those cells, that has both RNA-seq and BCR-seq data. Make sure that any cell at any moment of the analyzis has both RNA-seq and BCR-seq. Output the total number of such cells for all patients. Perform basic data pre-processing. Filter out cells with mitochondrial RNA content greater or equal 10%. Keep only the single AIR pair cells, and standard BCR receptor type. Perform the PCA analysis. Do you see a patient that stands up against the rest? Output their patient id or 'None'. Which two patients have the largest clonotypes? Output the VDJ sequence of the largest clonotype. In what condition is clonal expansion greater? Output one of: 'pre-vaccination' or 'post-vaccination'. Output the rate of clonal expansion change between pre and post-vaccination for young patients.
